description: Save the authorized sellers for a brand you own/manage — the whitelist that makes 'unauthorized seller' detection possible. The brand must already be tracked in this workspace. Use when the user says 'these are my authorized sellers for X', 'add Y to my authorized list', 'set my brand's approved resellers'. Pass the seller names exactly as they appear on Amazon.

brand.description: The brand (must be a tracked workspace brand).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR
